# Bluecore
> Bluecore is a Retail Performance Cloud purpose-built for marketers to trigger, prioritize, and personalize customer communication. It unifies CDP and ESP capabilities, enabling brands to deliver personalized experiences across email, site, SMS, paid ads, and even AI-powered conversations.
## Solutions
- [Identify and convert more shoppers](https://www.bluecore.com/solutions/identify-and-convert-shoppers/): Start tracking behavior before you even identify shoppers, and easily launch campaigns and triggers to increase list growth and conversion.
- [Execute one\-to\-one campaigns](https://www.bluecore.com/solutions/execute-one-to-one-campaigns/): Bluecore helps you execute and scale one-to-one campaigns in 90% less time, using fewer resources, to create the highly curated experiences.
- [Increase repeat purchases](https://www.bluecore.com/solutions/increase-repeat-purchases/): Bluecore helps you keep shoppers buying with powerful predictive models that activate your retail data to deepen engagement and repeat purchase.
## Platform
- [Platform Overview](https://www.bluecore.com/platform/): Bluecore’s digital personalization platform turns data into revenue-generating campaigns.
- [Email and mobile](https://www.bluecore.com/platform/email-and-mobile/): Built to execute 1:1 campaigns for retail — 90% faster.
- [Site](https://www.bluecore.com/platform/site/): Bluecore helps you rapidly execute one-to-one site campaigns to grow lists by 40% and conversion by 73%.
- [Advertise](https://www.bluecore.com/platform/paid-media-and-social/): Drive shoppers with a high likelihood of buying to your site.
- [Services \+ Success](https://www.bluecore.com/platform/services/): Get strategic support to drive more revenue with less effort.
- [Partners and integrations](https://www.bluecore.com/partners/): Extend Bluecore’s intelligence with powerful tech integrations.

## Blog
- [Culture Is the Real Roadblock to AI\-Enabled Media Orchestration](https://www.bluecore.com/blog/culture-is-the-roadblock-to-ai-media-orchestration/): AI\-powered media orchestration is within reach — but most retailers aren’t ready for it\. While the technology is advancing fast, the real blocker isn’t capability, it’s culture\.
- [The Context Revolution: Why AI Succeeds \(or Fails\) in Retail](https://www.bluecore.com/blog/the-context-revolution/): The potential of AI in retail cannot be realized without mastering context—learn how Bluecore's access to shopper\-behavior, product, and customer data eliminates noise to amplify the impact of AI\.
- [CRO Best Practices for AI Shopping Agents](https://www.bluecore.com/blog/cro-best-practices-for-ai-shopping-agents/): Launching your AI shopping agent is just the start—optimizing it is where the real impact happens\. Learn actionable CRO strategies to boost conversions, reduce returns, and elevate customer satisfaction\.
- [Demystifying AI for Ecommerce Brands: Agents vs\. Chatbots](https://www.bluecore.com/blog/demystifying-ai-for-ecommerce-brands-agents-vs-chatbots/): Are all AI solutions the same? Not quite\. Dive into the world of Ecommerce AI to uncover the key distinctions between reactive chatbots and proactive AI agents\. 
- [AI Assistants Are Now Shopping\. Are They Seeing Your Products?](https://www.bluecore.com/blog/what-is-mcp-server-ai-retail/): Learn what an MCP server is and why every retail e\-commerce site will need one to ensure AI assistants like ChatGPT accurately discover your brand’s products as consumers shift to Agent\-assisted shopping\.

## Resources
- [The Retail Trigger Playbook: How to Boost Revenue and Retention Beyond Cart Abandonment](https://www.bluecore.com/resources/retail-triggers-playbook/): Most retailers don’t use triggers to their full potential\. They drive ROI at every stage of the funnel, while also balancing well with batch sends and expanding to multichannel engagement\.
- [Benchmarks for Identification, Conversion, and Retention](https://www.bluecore.com/resources/customer-movement-benchmarks/): Rather than opens and clicks, Bluecore’s first\-of\-its\-kind benchmarks report is a deep dive into the customer\-led growth metrics that matter most, such as ID rate, repeat purchase rate, and retention rate\.
- [Timeless Tactics: How to Engage and Retain Luxury Buyers](https://www.bluecore.com/resources/luxury-retailers-guide/): Luxury retailer buyers range from regular big spenders to first\-time splurgers\. Understanding the difference and tailoring the experience accordingly is the key to engaging and retaining these shoppers\.
- [Fashion’s AI Evolution: How Shopping Agents Are Reinventing the Customer Experience](https://www.bluecore.com/resources/agentic-ai-skills-fashion/): Personalized styling is no longer reserved for in\-store VIPs\. Agentic AI brings that experience online for fashion retailers, with a variety of skills such as summarizing reviews and visual matching\.
- [Choosing an AI Shopping Agent: The Retailer’s Guide to Elevating Customer Experience and Driving Conversions with Gen AI](https://www.bluecore.com/resources/evaluating-ai-shopping-agent/): AI shopping agents can revolutionize your customer experience, but only if you know how to choose one\. Read on to learn how, including 34 questions to ask during your evaluation\.
## BFCM Resources
- [Bluecore’s 2023 Black Friday Benchmarks](https://www.bluecore.com/bfcm-resources/black-friday-trends-and-benchmarks/): Bluecore gathered Black Friday data in the retail industry to get insights into how shoppers are interacting with both brands and products\. 
- [The 2024 Martech Consolidation RFP](https://www.bluecore.com/bfcm-resources/martech-consolidation-rfp/): Nearly every retailer has been given the call to action to identify savings through technology consolidation\. Here’s how to approach consolidation, without sacrificing growth\.
- [Identification: The Secret Unlock for BFCM](https://www.bluecore.com/bfcm-resources/identification-the-unlock-for-bfcm/): Increase acquisition, retention and revenue before, during, and after the holidays by using identification as the foundation of your marketing efforts\.
- [The Four Classes of Customer Engagement](https://www.bluecore.com/bfcm-resources/the-four-classes-of-customer-engagement/): Prepare your brand experience to cater to all aspects of the desired customer lifecycle for your best holiday season yet\. A deep dive into behavior, merchandise, lifecycle, and broadcast\-based campaigns\.
- [Repeat Customers and Long\-Term Revenue: What Customer Movement Means to Carhartt](https://www.bluecore.com/bfcm-resources/repeat-customers-and-long-term-revenue-what-customer-movement-means-to-carhartt/): On this month's Coffee \& Commerce, Carhartt's Director of CRM shares how Customer Movement helps the brand create loyal customers\.

Orchestrate 1:1 retail personalization across every channel 
 
 
Bluecore unifies identity, behavior and product signals to deliver personalized experiences across email, SMS, site and paid media that drive profitable growth. 
 
 
 
Talk to us 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
DXL expands with Bluecore.
 
 
When “doing more with less” can actually get you more. DXL was under pressure to drive more growth with less overhead. 
By consolidating onto Bluecore, DXL can now manage identification, audience building and segmentation, campaign orchestration, and media integrations all from one platform.
 
 
 
Get the full story 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Meet Marketing Agent
 
Your always-on marketing analyst and operator
 
 
Learn more 
 
 
 
 
Know every shopper. 
Personalize every moment. 
Scale with AI.
 
 
Make retail context actionable with Bluecore AI and turn signals into sales. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Data & Insight
 
With real-time shopper identity, behavioral data, product data, and predictive models built directly into campaign workflows, Bluecore turns intelligence into action.
This three-pronged dataset creates the most complete customer profiles to understand intent and preferences, which are the predictors of future behavior and conversion.
This intelligence feeds more than 20 predictive AI models – from category and discount affinity to next-best purchase and at-risk buyers – so every message is 1:1.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Activation & Orchestration
 
Bluecore was built to deliver data–rich, real-time experiences as a combined CDP and Experience Orchestration solution. 
Scale personalized experience delivery with hundreds of cross-channel triggers that are ready to respond to any signal or event to keep customers engaged and purchasing at their individual moments of intent.
With reduction in manual workflows, Bluecore campaigns can be built at the speed that your customer is moving, with 80% less production time compared to other providers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI Shopping Agents
 
Help your shoppers discover, research, and buy with confidence, wherever they are. 
We go far beyond product recommendations with our AI. Your agent can serve as a stylist, trendspotter, review summarizer, affinity predictor, researcher, comparison builder and more. 
Our Shopping Agent Platform gives you tools to set guardrails, define voice and tone, and align your agent with your brand values. Monitor conversations in real time, create custom rules, and ensure security with built-in protections that keep your business compliant and your data safe.

Creating a profitable customer base requires customer-led technology.
 
 
 
Old World
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
New World
 
 
 
 
 
 
The channel-led strategy is characterized by low retention and customer survival rates – 
average 22% 3-year retention rate, and more than 2x lower than leading brands.
 This eats into a retailer’s growth and compounds over time. 
Teams are operating in channel silos with a short supply of signal to drive customer movement through the lifecycle and end up over-investing in bottom-funnel performance to hit year-over-year comps.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Retailers and DTC brands who shift to customer-led technology are driving higher retention and long-term growth.
Retailers Bluecore retailers see 
an average 59% 2-year retention rate — more than 2x higher than lagging brands. 
This approach is built on real-time shopper identification, customer signals, and product insights, seamlessly activated across channels and conversations. The result? Hitting comps, lower costs, and a more engaged, profitable customer base.

 THE RETAIL MARKETING PLATFORM 
 
 
 
Turn data into 
revenue-generating campaigns — fast.
Built to make personalization for retailers easy — because existing marketing platforms don’t.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The sacred trio of data
 — shopper + behavior + product.
When shopper behavior (think: browse, search, click) meets product data (like: just added, out of stock, price drop) in one workflow, retailers can instantly communicate with shoppers at the right time, in the right place.
Bluecore’s dynamic, flexible integration capabilities quickly unlock value from your data — from in-store to loyalty to product data. Whether it’s captured by our platform or dormant in your current tech stack, Bluecore makes all your data more powerful so you can drive more revenue.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Triggers that print money now
 — and even more in a few minutes.
Easily configurable, always-on triggers are the gift that keeps on giving — constantly organizing shopper, behavioral, and product data into audiences you can instantly act on, in any channel.
With product triggers like price drop, new arrival, and back-in-stock, you don’t have to stop at the handful of basic triggers that other platforms offer. Optimize with a click, and drive incremental sales effortlessly, in minutes, without custom tech configurations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Predictive models designed for retail — 
at your fingertips. 
Bluecore’s out-of-the-box predictive models are built and trained on billions of data points across hundreds of brands. That makes them stronger, smarter, and more accurate than those of any other provider.
And what’s even better is that they’re incredibly easy to use. Point and click to use the models directly in an audience builder — and then build dynamic, always-on audiences that keep shoppers buying, prevent lapse, preserve margins, increase efficiency of spend, and more.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built-in workflows that
 reduce time to campaign launch by 90%.
Pull your dynamic audiences into quick-build templates that give you both guidance and flexibility by offering built-in recommendations or letting you customize your own rules. Spin up compelling creative and curated content, offers, and recommendations for each shopper — without relying on list pulls or endless IT and creative requests.
You get more time to test and learn, and shoppers get content and product recommendations that are unique to them — when they want to see them, in whichever channel they prefer to buy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Go from one test a quarter to 
multiple tests a week.
Marketers need to stay one step ahead of the changing needs of shoppers to drive incremental revenue quickly. With built-in testing, run reliable tests in a few clicks — and get full visibility into results and analytics at the customer, product, and channel levels. No translation required.
Optimize quickly, capture opportunities daily, and constantly track progress — without putting in a single ticket with analytics.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
“Bluecore helps us quickly access and activate the data we already have to create more fluid experiences across channels — and the revenue gains naturally follow.”
Eric Gohs
Former SVP Digital + Customer Marketing | Lane Bryant
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Strategy and services 
designed by born-and-bred retail marketers.
Retail is a unique industry that requires tailored solutions. Bluecore is managed by former retail marketing executives who have owned performance marketing, data, and analytics.
This puts us in a perfect position to provide industry-specific, strategic support to cater to each brand’s needs. From marketing campaign gap analyses to technical services for unique use cases, our retail experts guide brands on their best path to predictable revenue — independent of the larger environment.

Overview
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Bluecore is an identification and customer movement technology for e-commerce. We help retailers identify and move customers through the lifecycle more efficiently, and that’s without overspamming or sacrificing long-term relationships with the brand.
